For Research Use Only. Not for human or veterinary use. Not for use in diagnostic or therapeutic procedures. Not approved by the FDA or any regulatory body for human consumption, treatment, cure, or prevention of any disease.

Glutathione is a naturally occurring tripeptide supplied for in-vitro research into cellular redox-signaling and antioxidant-pathway models.

In research settings, Glutathione is studied for its role in reactive-oxygen-species scavenging, particularly in models evaluating glutathione-peroxidase and glutathione-S-transferase enzymatic pathways relevant to oxidative-stress regulation.
